assumptions: The founder can describe a developer audience and provide at least one problem phrase.
The project has a read-only custom API connection to the public Hacker News Search API.
Public search results are a bounded sample and do not establish market demand or reply eligibility.
effects: Makes at most five read-only Hacker News Search API requests.
Does not post, message users, create accounts, or modify Hacker News.
cost_drivers: One managed model call when search results contain candidates.
The number and length of problem queries, bounded to five API requests.

cases.description: Find recent developer discussions about a concrete problem and prepare a human-reviewed queue.

inputs.notes: Do not claim features not shown in project evidence.

rubric.question: Does every candidate have a working Hacker News item link and evidence that the discussion matches the audience and problem?
Would each draft still help the person if all product references were removed, and are product claims supported by project evidence?
Does the report clearly leave checking community rules and posting to a person, with no automatic external action?
